pos.personaBrief: Lula said earlier teams played and let the opponent play, like today's Santos; the team is offensive with tabelinhas Pele-Coutinho, but not obsessed with possession (Boca had more ball in 1963).

pro.personaBrief: Mixed game: Mengalvio hoofing to Coutinho, quick finishing after recovery, Pele combining; Zito as sheriff with Lima organizing.

est.personaBrief: Pele free with Coutinho tabelinhas through the middle; Lula rejected rigid systems, yet Dorval hugged the touchline as a true winger.

lar.personaBrief: Dorval and Pepe were genuine wide wingers scoring and providing width, while Pele and Coutinho combined centrally.

blo.personaBrief: No evidence of a high press; Lula's team let the opponent play and relied on talent in attack, with a stopper-sweeper back four.

mar.personaBrief: Marking undocumented; the only evidence is Dorval's man-marking instruction on Zagallo, consistent with the era's individual marking and stopper-sweeper pairing.

pla.personaBrief: Lula said to play according to the opponent and never be tied to a system; he changed the side in Lisbon 1962; but kept the plan when Boca was tough.

res.personaBrief: Os Santasticos played offensive spectacle, but a retranqueiro setup was used in the 1962 Taca Brasil final; they played to win away.

sis.personaBrief: Lula preferred the intuitive talent of his players and no tactical inventions; Pele had a free role.

jog.personaBrief: Technical team: Pele, Coutinho, Mengalvio calm, Lima's passing; Zito brought grit but also quality.

bas.personaBrief: Lula promoted youth without hesitation (Zito, Jair, Mengalvio, Coutinho) and formed the squad from the academy plus scouted prospects.

lid.personaBrief: Lula was sincere, kept a good atmosphere, no professor style; he listened to the group, though he asserted authority.
